faq.more_a: Our support team is available 7 days a week to answer all your questions

items.q: Do I need technical skills to create a store on Commerco?
items.a: Not at all. Commerco is designed for the everyday Algerian merchant. You can create your store, add your products and start selling in under an hour, with zero coding or technical knowledge.

items.q: How do customers reach my store in every wilaya?
items.a: Your Commerco store supports delivery to all 48 Algerian wilayas through certified shipping partners. The customer picks their wilaya at checkout and the order lands straight in your dashboard.

items.q: Which payment methods are available to customers?
items.a: Cash on delivery (COD) is the main and preferred method for Algerians. We are working on adding online payment soon as it becomes available in the Algerian market.

items.q: What is Confirmili and do I need it?
items.a: Confirmili is a dedicated dashboard for confirming orders and managing delivery, similar to Octomatic. It helps you track every order, confirm it, follow its status and send reports to shipping companies. Available on the Pro plan.

items.q: Can I connect my store to other platforms like YouCan or Shopify?
items.a: Yes. On the Pro and Business plans you can connect your store to other platforms via Confirmili integrations, including YouCan, WooCommerce and Google Sheets for order and inventory sync.

items.q: What happens if I exceed my plan order limit?
items.a: You will get a notification at 80% of your monthly limit. Your service is never cut off automatically — you get a short grace period while you upgrade. Upgrading takes one click from the dashboard.
